理想单线圈交流发电机，N·B·A = 1 V·s，手柄与线圈 1∶1；电阻为 1: Ideal single-coil AC generator: N·B·A = 1 V·s, crank-to-coil ratio 1:1, resistance 10 Ω. No battery, rectifier or energy storage.
θ 是线圈法线与磁场 B 的夹角；磁通链为 K cos θ，电压为 K ω si: θ is the angle between the coil normal and magnetic field B. Flux linkage is K cos θ; voltage is K ω sin θ. Current sign follows the chosen winding convention and reverses every half-turn. Reverse changes the speed sign at the same angle.
灯光用周期平均电功率示意，不模拟真实灯丝热惯性与亮度曲线。立体模型展示磁极、线圈: Light represents cycle-mean electrical power, without real filament thermal inertia or a brightness curve. The 3D model shows poles, coil and slip rings; winding count and proportions are simplified, not assembly instructions.
能量来自手做功。更快转动、带动负载都需要机械输入；此处不模拟手的力矩、摩擦或温升: Energy comes from hand work. Faster rotation and a connected load require mechanical input. Hand torque, friction and temperature rise are not simulated.
一圈手摇，一点光。: One crank turn, a little light.
拖动旋转 · 点摇柄启动 · 点开关接通电路 · 双击复位: Drag to rotate · click crank to start · click switch to connect · double-click to reset
手摇交流发电机示意，铜线圈在磁铁间转动，经滑环电刷接入灯泡: Hand-crank AC generator. A copper coil rotates between magnets, connecting to the bulb through slip rings and brushes.
一周期交流电压相位示意，标点表示当前角度: One-cycle AC voltage phase. The dot marks the current angle.

磁通的变化产生电压。不是“有磁铁就一直有电”，停止转动，输出立即归零。: Changing magnetic flux produces voltage. A magnet alone does not produce continuous electricity; stopping rotation makes the output zero.
手柄停止，感应电压为零: Crank stopped; induced voltage is zero
线圈磁通链 {0} V·s；瞬时电压 {1} V。磁通最大时电压为零，变化最快时: Coil flux linkage {0} V·s; instantaneous voltage {1} V. Voltage is zero at maximum flux and greatest when flux changes fastest. {2}
灯泡接入，电流随电压换向。: With the bulb connected, current reverses with voltage.
转动时，开路仍可有感应电压；但电流与灯功率为零。: An open circuit can still have induced voltage during rotation, but current and bulb power are zero.
停止转动，电压与电流归零。: Rotation stopped; voltage and current are zero.

电路断开，灯泡没有功率。: Circuit open; the bulb receives no power.
功率不足，稍微摇快一点。: Not enough power. Crank a little faster.
保持这个节奏，正在累计达标时间。: Keep this pace. Time within target is accumulating.
